findings.why: AC-1 test relies on json.dumps(sort_keys=True) to sort keys during serialization, so it stays green even when snapshot() returns the dict in JSONL write order. Mutation confirmed: replacing snapshot()'s return with the unsorted latest dict leaves all 4 tests passing. AD-13 requires sorted insertion order on the dict itself, but the test never asserts list(first.keys()).

AC-4 test uses dict equality and set-of-keys, both of which ignore insertion order. An unsorted snapshot() return also satisfies these assertions, so the test does not verify the byte-stability AD-13 promises for cross-instance reads.
